preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and 1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in N_list)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in A) for A in A_list)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the array A contains N integers between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip() == '-1') or (len(line.split()) == N_list[i] and sorted(line.split()) == sorted(A_list[i])) for i, line in enumerate(stdout_lines))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the output is either '-1' or a permutation of the input array A_i.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip() == '-1') or (not any((B[j] <= B[j+1] <= B[j+2]) or (B[j] >= B[j+1] >= B[j+2]) for j in range(len(B)-2)) for B in [list(map(int, line.split())) if line.strip() != '-1' else [] for line in stdout_lines]))
postconditions.description: If the output for a test case is not '-1', the resulting array B has no subarray of length 3 or more that is non-increasing or non-decreasing.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip() == '-1') == (not any((not any((B[j] <= B[j+1] <= B[j+2]) or (B[j] >= B[j+1] >= B[j+2]) for j in range(len(B)-2)) for B in [list(map(int, perm)) for perm in __import__('itertools').permutations(A_list[i])])) for i, line in enumerate(stdout_lines))
postconditions.description: The output is '-1' if and only if no permutation of the input array A_i satisfies the interesting array condition.
